metadata.title: AuthOS Reliability Baseline Evaluation Report
metadata.notice: SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT EVALUATION ONLY. Not clinical validation.

safety_gates.name: zero_false_positive_met
safety_gates.description: Zero false-positive MET results permitted across all adversarial non-MET cases.

safety_gates.name: zero_cross_patient_leakage
safety_gates.description: Zero cross-patient evidence leakage permitted across verification and retrieval.

safety_gates.name: exact_provenance_integrity
safety_gates.description: Exact quote offsets and source existence enforced without fabrication.

safety_gates.name: determinism_verified
safety_gates.description: 100% deterministic output across repeated executions on identical inputs.

metric_definitions.precision_per_class: TP / (TP + FP) or null if denominator is 0
metric_definitions.recall_per_class: TP / (TP + FN) or null if denominator is 0
metric_definitions.f1_per_class: 2 * P * R / (P + R) or null if P/R undefined
metric_definitions.mrr: 1 / rank of first relevant retrieved item
